line: Crowley's Three of Cups is the card for the second decan of Cancer, with Mercury as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Cancer.

quotes.quote: The Three of Cups is called the Lord of Abundance.
The card is referred to the influence of Mercury in Cancer

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: It is the spiritual basis of fertility.
